# Getting Started

> nbdev lets Python developers write, test, and document packages entirely inside Jupyter notebooks, automatically exporting clean source modules, running tests, and publishing documentation from a single notebook-centric workflow.



## Guide

- [Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md): In the interest of fostering an open and welcoming environment, we as contributors and maintainers pledge to make participation in our project and our community a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, disability, ethnicity, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.
- [An Example Markdown Post](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/tests/2020-01-14-test-markdown-post.md): A minimal example of using markdown with fastpages.
- [Essential Work-From-Home Advice: Cheap and Easy Ergonomic Setups](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/tests/2022-09-06-homeschooling.md): Lorem ipsum

## Source Modules

- [nbdev.clean](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbdev/clean.py)
- [nbdev.cli](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbdev/cli.py): Use `nb_export` on ipynb files in `nbs` directory on changes using nbdev config if available
- [nbdev.config](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbdev/config.py)
- [nbdev.diff](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbdev/diff.py)
- [nbdev.doclinks](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbdev/doclinks.py)
- [nbdev.export](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbdev/export.py)
- [nbdev.extract_attachments](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbdev/extract_attachments.py)
- [nbdev.frontmatter](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbdev/frontmatter.py)
- [nbdev.maker](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbdev/maker.py)
- [nbdev.merge](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbdev/merge.py)
- [nbdev.migrate](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbdev/migrate.py)
- [nbdev.processors](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbdev/processors.py): Strips "hidden" metadata property from code cells so it doesn't interfere with docs rendering
- [nbdev.qmd](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbdev/qmd.py)
- [nbdev.quarto](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbdev/quarto.py): Create CONTRIBUTING.md from contributing_nb (defaults to 'contributing.ipynb' if present). Skips if the file doesn't exist.
- [nbdev.release](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbdev/release.py)
- [nbdev.scrubmagics](https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/nbdev/blob/main/nbdev/scrubmagics.py)
